name: Huétor Tájar (Spain)
description: Red field crossed by a horizontal stripe chequy of blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Huétor Tájar (a crescent on red above white).
history: Huétor Tájar adopted its arms and flag officially on 19 February 2002; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3, red, crossed by a chequy stripe of blue and yellow pieces, with the crowned arms superimposed at the centre.

features.role: stripe chequy of blue and yellow across the centre
